description: The Terna Data Portal is where Terna, the Italian transmission system operator, publishes its operating data, market data and electricity system statistics. Its Download Center offers data on requirements (demand), generation, transmission, market, adequacy, fees and outages in table and Excel format, updated in real time except for sections updated the next day, such as Italian demand, net and renewable generation, the energy balance and foreign and domestic physical trade. Load is available by market zone, for example North, Centre-North, Centre-South, South, Calabria, Sicily and Sardinia. When read on 26 September 2026 the home page showed total load for Italy at 11:15, actual generation and net exchange for that day. The Terna Developer Portal offers APIs; a maintenance notice said the Plant Master Data API was suspended from 13 May 2026, and private APIs for settlement and measurements are requested through MyTerna. Coverage is Italy by market zone. Downloads are free; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: some API services are suspended or private, and zone definitions change over time. Simulation uses are zonal demand, generation and exchange series for Italian grid and adequacy models and stress event analysis. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform carries Italian data in the European format.
